reference_library_scope: Unmodified library and vendor fingerprint; scoring profile and one supplementary product are applied at runtime after reference admission.

hg.channels: Six Y/Z channels, B1 and dehydrated B1
hg.prior_to_saturation: mean of at most two strongest distinct matched peaks

gm3_protonated.admission: Reference Y/Z >= 3 and B >= 2. Shared chain confirmation is separate.

remaining_acidic_profiles: Per-class positive ion weight overrides with existing default pools and fixed evidence admission. Negative ion profiles retain reference scoring.
